ref: ADR-0008 "JSON as a source at run time" (an array property reads each item of its array as one occurrence; a null item reads as the empty string) and GLOSSARY "Array property"; #118
note: PO message mappings have no JSON source, so the reading is decided. $/maybe is a nillable array property at 0..1 and its array holds one null item: one occurrence of maybe whose value reads as the empty string, so one empty All is written. Read by its maximum, maybe would be a leaf, the array would read as absent and no All would be written.
